values.note: Winter camping is limited to 4-6 Pinnacle sites with electric and vault toilets, by reservation.

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people per site; one hard-sided RV, trailer or van and one tent, or two tents. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass. Reservations are taken May 15 to September 30 park-wide; in winter only Pinnacle takes them (4-6 sites).

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/stagecoach-state-park/stagecoach-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Stagecoach State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'Reservations at Stagecoach are available from May 15 to September 30. During the winter, reservations are available at Pinnacle campground.'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Electric sites $36 a night in June, a Saturday the same. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($12-$17) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: cpwshop.com parkID 50040 1-night prices for 2027-06-15 and 2027-06-19 (co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl) + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/stagecoach-state-park ('Daily Vehicle Pass: $12-$17'), read 2026-10-27

note: Largest of Stagecoach State Park's four campgrounds, on the north shore of Stagecoach Reservoir near the marina, south of Steamboat Springs. The only loop open in winter. --Claude
